name: Boogie Woogie
description: A Wang network of yellow street lines that meet, turn and stop where the edge rules say, with small red, blue and gray blocks set along them.

code.style: --rule: ( --gate: @r(1); --s: @pd(@r(0, 50)); --ix: @x; --iy: @y; --xr: $(round((160 + 100 * floor(0.5 + (sin(ix * 12.9898 + iy * 78.233 + s * 1) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1)) * 100 / 3) / 100)%; --xl: $(round((140 - 100 * max(0, 2 - ix) * floor(0.5 + (sin((ix - 1) * 12.9898 + iy * 78.233 + s * 1) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1)) * 100 / 3) / 100)%; --yb: $(round((160 + 100 * floor(0.5 + (sin(ix * 39.3467 + iy * 11.1351 + s * 1.7) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1)) * 100 / 3) / 100)%; --yt: $(round((140 - 100 * max(0, 2 - iy) * floor(0.5 + (sin(ix * 39.3467 + (iy - 1) * 11.1351 + s * 1.7) * 43758.5453 % 1 + 1) % 1)) * 100 / 3) / 100)%; --ln: polygon(@var(--xl) 46.67%, @var(--xr) 46.67%, @var(--xr) 53.33%, @var(--xl) 53.33%, @var(--xl) 46.67%, 46.67% @var(--yt), 53.33% @var(--yt), 53.33% @var(--yb), 46.67% @var(--yb), 46.67% @var(--yt)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -100%; top: -100%; width: 300%; height: 300%; background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--ln); clip-path: @var(--ln); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 40%; top: 40%; width: 20%; height: 20%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color1), var(--color1)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
